requirements.title: Define the bounded decision contract beside the existing model runner
requirements.outcome: Represent one return-intake classification task through project-owned request/result types while reusing the existing provider and capability mechanisms.
original_acceptance_criteria: A fixed return-intake request can be represented without a Cloudflare model ID, proprietary thread, raw credential, or caller-selected business authority in its logical task contract.
Missing answers, unknown options, unsupported question types, nonfinite values, and materially invalid distributions produce an unusable result rather than a classification eligible for later action.
A syntactically valid answer that includes a proposed refund or permission change is rejected or ignored outside the defined schema and cannot invoke the existing action gateway.

requirements.title: Add merchant question resources and source-bound evidence snapshots

Cross-tenant or unpermitted case data cannot enter the input snapshot, and unavailable source data is represented as unavailable rather than verified absence.
The same authorized source revisions and preprocessing version reproduce the recorded input hash; material evidence or question changes create a distinct observation version.
An oversized input that would lose required evidence takes an explicit review/unavailable path instead of silently submitting a truncated decision input.

requirements.outcome: Send the bounded decision request through a controlled Clef-flash REST adapter, with a fully exercised fixture transport and separately recorded connected qualification.
original_acceptance_criteria: The fixture captures the documented URL, authorization placement, model/state/questions body, and envelope normalization for a successful text-only request.

Timeout, non-success response, invalid schema, oversized response, or credential revocation yields an explicit unusable/unavailable observation and does not trigger unapproved destination or billing fallback.
Raw credentials are absent from skill input, model state, user-visible output, and captured logs/receipts; disabling the adapter leaves the current manual workflow available.
The evidence record states whether a request was fixture-only or actually executed; absent live credentials leave latency/quality/provider qualification pending.

requirements.title: Record useful shadow classifications in the existing case workflow
requirements.outcome: Allow an authorized operator or existing skill invocation to record a proposed return-intake classification beside the same case without changing its operational outcome.
original_acceptance_criteria: An authorized synthetic case completes case-to-snapshot-to-adapter-to-validated-receipt processing through the existing interface.
A shadow result changes neither assignment nor eligibility, money, inventory, approval, or settlement state; the operator can continue the original manual workflow.
Replaying the recorded observation preserves its original evidence while requesting a fresh inference creates a separately versioned observation.
Provider-disabled and invalid-result cases remain usable through the existing manual path and clearly expose that no usable inference was produced.

requirements.title: Enable bounded case routing with takeover and revocation
requirements.outcome: Allow a qualified classification to select an existing permitted queue or skill through published server rules while preserving review and operator control.
original_acceptance_criteria: A current qualified result can perform only an allowed existing route; the same result cannot grant a financial action, approval, or expanded permission.
Human takeover, revoked qualification, a kill switch, or stale relevant case facts fences a late routing result before it changes ownership or sends a message.
Ambiguous, unusable, or provider-unavailable decisions enter the declared review/manual path, and disabling the model preserves ordinary case handling.
The routing receipt records the source decision and publication version, while classification accuracy remains distinct from actual case resolution.

Backend-specific distributions, confidence meanings, limits, and numerical differences are preserved in evidence; a shared field name does not silently transfer a threshold.
Fixture conformance proves only transport behavior; actual replacement/portability qualification remains pending until the second implementation is exercised.

requirements.title: Define one remote trust profile over current task authority
requirements.outcome: Specify a remote identity and sender-binding contract whose only authority comes from verified issuer claims and existing server-side task permissions.
original_acceptance_criteria: The contract names one supported profile, trusted configuration sources, token/key binding and identity-to-task mapping; each field has an explicit trusted source or server lookup.
Two synthetic tenants using the same public task shape still resolve to different permitted resources; forged tenant, customer, role or task claims cannot increase authority.
Local opaque and remote profiles have separate validation paths and truthful compatibility labels. Selecting an unsupported issuer or confirmation mechanism leaves remote access disabled.

requirements.title: Verify sender proof at the actual remote resource boundary
requirements.outcome: Require a valid sender-bound token and a fresh proof on each supported remote request, with no bearer downgrade.
original_acceptance_criteria: A properly bound token and proof reaches the existing permitted read/proposal path; the same token without a proof or with a different sender key is rejected before resource access.
Wrong method, target URI, token hash, token audience, expired proof, disallowed algorithm and an untrusted proxy-origin substitution are rejected with bounded, non-secret diagnostics.
A proof-valid request with a changed amount, query resource or proposed action still undergoes existing permission, schema, policy and exact-preview checks; sender proof grants no business approval.

requirements.title: Fence replay, revocation and active work across verifier processes
requirements.outcome: Make proof replay and current task restrictions effective across concurrent requests, restarts and lease renewal.
original_acceptance_criteria: Two verifier processes race the same valid proof against the shared store: at most one request is admitted. A restart within the proof window does not make the proof reusable.
Revoked membership/session, an expired task, a stop revision and a stale lease generation deny the relevant next operation or renewal even when the token and cryptographic proof are valid.
Replay-store failure denies protected access and records a bounded reason; recovery restores service without accepting retained replays or reopening expired tasks.
An ambiguous synthetic effect followed by an authenticated takeover remains attached to its original operation identity and proceeds through reconciliation without a second send.

requirements.title: Exercise bounded independent-client continuation

original_acceptance_criteria: An independent client reads the permitted synthetic case and prepares a return proposal; a separate authorized operator can review it using the existing manual flow.
Client replacement fences the previous owner's next operation and does not extend the original expiry, add a store or restore revoked permissions.
A requested broader or longer-lived delegated task is rejected or narrowed by the supported issuer/server contract; an unsupported delegation mechanism fails explicitly.
The replacement client receives only its allowed case context, and the compatibility record distinguishes server-enforced scope from unobserved external-host behavior.

Disabling or misconfiguring the remote profile denies its routes while existing authorized local/manual work remains usable; no implicit bearer or portal-only fallback appears.
The release claim lists supported remote operations and unqualified transports/providers without changing the checkpoint's existing accepted-goal ledger.

The broker design identifies the actual enforcement point and task identity for every supported output channel, including model traffic and retained traces.

A bounded over-budget process is terminated by the actual runtime limit and cannot continue broker operations after its task deadline or stop.
The evidence records the exact image/runtime, effective isolation configuration and observed boundary, with unsupported platforms left unqualified.

original_acceptance_criteria: A supported tracking-to-exchange or shopping-to-edit conversation preserves the original case and the exact underlying previews, approvals and receipts.
Changing an item, amount, order or source version invalidates the affected preview before execution; a conversation acknowledgement cannot substitute for required approval.
If one operation is unknown, the journey displays that uncertainty and reconciles the original operation before initiating a conflicting effect.

requirements.title: Make follow-ups reflect current journey state
requirements.outcome: Use existing event rules and consent controls to update or suppress a planned follow-up when the shopper's journey changes.
original_acceptance_criteria: A purchase, resolved return, changed fit preference or completed order edit updates or suppresses the corresponding waiting follow-up.
Duplicate events create one logical follow-up; late events cannot reopen a completed recovery sequence or multiply its exposure metrics.
Opt-out, takeover or lost channel authority at final send prevents delivery while retaining a truthful manual follow-up state.

requirements.title: Qualify journey continuity across callers
requirements.outcome: Exercise the same declared journey through the manual interface, built-in agent and independent remote client, preserving authority and durable state.
original_acceptance_criteria: A new qualified caller continues an open journey from published facts and receipts without a private provider thread or the old runtime's checkpoint.
The old caller loses its permitted actions after handover; a late response cannot send a message or replay a completed effect.
The no-model path remains operable during model outage, and release evidence distinguishes local fixtures from actual remote-client and channel observations.

requirements.title: Normalize qualified loyalty balances and rules
requirements.outcome: Expose source-backed loyalty state and provider capabilities through one merchant-scoped contract.
original_acceptance_criteria: A balance snapshot identifies account, customer binding, source revision, observed time and supported operations; stale or incomplete balances cannot authorize redemption.
Points, money and store credit retain separate units and ledgers; unsupported conversions are rejected.
A provider lacking reversals or reservations exposes that limitation instead of emulating a successful financial operation.

requirements.title: Link loyalty accrual to order changes
requirements.outcome: Derive qualified accrual and reversal proposals from original paid line allocations and subsequent eligible financial events.
original_acceptance_criteria: A partial refund proposes the documented reversal for only its eligible original lines; repeated exchanges preserve their original lineage.
Duplicate or reordered financial events do not accrue or reverse the same entitlement twice.
A refund with missing settlement or provider evidence remains an explicit pending/discrepant loyalty state and does not alter the recorded financial truth.

requirements.title: Reserve and reconcile loyalty redemption
requirements.outcome: Execute supported loyalty redemption through exact approved terms, bounded reservations and original-identity reconciliation.
original_acceptance_criteria: Two concurrent redemptions cannot spend the same available entitlement. An unknown redemption continues to encumber its points across reservation expiry, timeout and restart until authoritative reconciliation or cancellation resolves the outcome; another redemption cannot consume that reserved balance.
A timeout after provider acceptance remains unknown and is reconciled by original operation ID without another redemption.
Provider-specific insufficient-balance or reversal behavior is surfaced accurately; the system creates no unapproved monetary charge.

requirements.title: Quote loyalty-aware recovery incentives
requirements.outcome: Let existing support and recovery skills compare permitted loyalty incentives with other approved offers without acquiring enrollment or send authority.
original_acceptance_criteria: An incentive quote shows current earning or redemption terms, eligible items, expiration and source references; generated wording cannot improve those terms.
Enrollment, redemption and message delivery require their separate existing authority; agreeing to a shopping recommendation grants none of them implicitly.
A purchase, opt-out or balance change before send invalidates or suppresses the affected offer.

requirements.title: Reconcile the complete loyalty lifecycle
requirements.outcome: Expose and qualify source differences across a purchase, redemption, edit and return using the existing operator exception and economic reporting paths.
original_acceptance_criteria: A declared end-to-end scenario ties local accrual/redemption/reversal records to the provider's observed balance and event identities.
Unsupported or missing reversal evidence remains an exception, and an otherwise authorized customer refund continues through its own existing path.
Economic reporting distinguishes issued points, expected liabilities under documented rules, redeemed costs and measured recovery outcomes.

A late provider event or restored snapshot cannot recreate erased customer content; only authorized minimized accounting and reconciliation linkage is retained. Provider-side coverage is recorded separately.

requirements.title: Discover eligible drop-off choices
requirements.outcome: Present methods and sites only when current partner, item and destination qualifications support the requested return.
original_acceptance_criteria: A permitted item/category/geography receives only currently qualified methods and site choices with their actual packaging and fee terms.
A revoked contract, unavailable site or excluded item removes the choice before credential issuance.
Missing availability evidence is shown as unverified rather than silently treated as an eligible site.

requirements.title: Issue and replace provider-bound handoff credentials
requirements.outcome: Bind each drop-off credential to the exact approved return items, provider, method, expiry and operation identity.
original_acceptance_criteria: Issued credentials reference the approved item set and provider terms; a changed return or fee invalidates the unsent request.
A timeout cannot trigger a second credential request with a new operation identity until the original outcome is reconciled.
Expired or replaced credentials remain unusable according to qualified provider semantics, and their secret payload is absent from normal logs.

requirements.title: Record item-level drop-off acceptance
requirements.outcome: Map authenticated provider handoff observations to the existing return and custody records with expected-versus-actual item distinctions.
original_acceptance_criteria: A two-item credential with only one accepted item records that item's handoff and leaves the other outstanding.
A duplicate or wrong-return scan cannot increase received quantity or move another customer's return.
A handoff event records only its qualified physical stage and cannot by itself assert warehouse inspection or refund settlement.

requirements.title: Expose consolidation and custody continuity
requirements.outcome: Project provider consolidation and subsequent movement into shopper/operator views using the existing custody ledger.
original_acceptance_criteria: Each accepted item is traceable through reported consolidation and receiving references without creating a second stock balance.
Missing movement, rejected custody or partial arrival remains explicit; elapsed time cannot advance the return.
Corrected membership or fee observations retain linked provenance and cannot duplicate goods or charges.

requirements.title: Qualify the shopper drop-off experience
requirements.outcome: Validate instructions, credential accessibility, partner failure behavior and the precise supported financial trigger for one declared method.
original_acceptance_criteria: A shopper completes the qualified method using accurate site, fee, packaging and expiry instructions; an accessible alternative is available for the declared device profile.
An outage before issuance or after handoff shows a recoverable state without inventing a replacement credential or final resolution.
The release record distinguishes synthetic events from the observed physical handoff, receiving stage and separately observed financial result.

requirements.title: Version warehouse topology and bin constraints
requirements.outcome: Represent one warehouse's bins, traversable connections and access constraints separately from the authoritative inventory ledger.
original_acceptance_criteria: Published topology refers to existing qualified locations and identifies disconnected or forbidden routes before planning.
Changing a bin placement or access edge increments the topology revision and invalidates affected unsent route proposals.
Topology updates do not create, move or adjust stock.

requirements.outcome: Build bounded deterministic wave/route proposals from current eligible orders, allocations and the published layout.
original_acceptance_criteria: A proposal references each allocated item, route stop and source revision and obeys the declared access and capacity constraints.
Stock, hold, allocation or layout changes before claim invalidate the affected proposal rather than preserving a stale route.
The declared benchmark compares distance or travel cost against its named baseline without sacrificing item or order correctness.

requirements.title: Coordinate pickers, totes and packer handoffs
requirements.outcome: Execute a claimed wave through the existing scan/packing APIs with durable picker and tote ownership.
original_acceptance_criteria: Only the current picker may advance its claimed stops; two pickers cannot consume the same allocation.
Wrong-bin, wrong-item or wrong-tote scans produce a discrepancy without inflating picked or packed quantity.
After connection loss or lease expiry, the client refreshes persisted state and current ownership; replayed scans affect quantity once.

requirements.title: Record supplies usage with source ownership
requirements.outcome: Map explicit label, packaging and other declared consumable-use observations into the existing location inventory ledger.
original_acceptance_criteria: A configured physical-use event decrements the correct consumable and location once, using exact pack/unit conversions.
Reprinting, voiding or retrying a label is not assumed to consume or restore stock without its declared source observation.
Duplicate usage and corrected counts retain original/correction identities and cannot produce negative or duplicated inventory silently.

requirements.title: Prepare supplies replenishment and gate recurring purchases
requirements.outcome: Default to threshold/scheduled PO drafts that account for stock and open orders; optionally execute recurring purchases only through a separately activated, bounded merchant mandate and qualified supplier.
original_acceptance_criteria: Without an explicitly active mandate capability, a threshold or schedule creates only one explainable PO draft. Repeated observations, open POs and partial receipts cannot duplicate the same uncovered need or authorize a supplier call.

When the optional path is separately qualified, a principal with M11-G06 procurement approval authority approves its versioned mandate terms, preserving required separation of duties. The proposing or executing agent cannot activate or widen it. Each occurrence rechecks current mandate and authorizing authority, fixed merchant/supplier/SKU terms, stock and open-PO evidence, exact purchase preview, approved quantities and atomic per-order/aggregate spend reservations. Covered changes require new approval.

A timeout after supplier acceptance keeps the original mandate occurrence and purchase identity unknown. Its unresolved stock/order commitment and applicable mandate/budget reservations persist across timeout, restart, mandate expiry and later triggers until authoritative reconciliation or cancellation resolves the outcome. Retries reconcile the original identity; another occurrence cannot consume the same committed need or reserved capacity.

Revocation, expiry, changed supplier or price outside approved bounds before dispatch blocks the recurring effect and preserves a draft/exception. The evidence states whether only drafts or actual qualified mandate execution was observed.

A private support note, unverified inference or forbidden source field cannot be selected as campaign evidence.
Changing required sources, claims or strategy rules invalidates the affected draft qualification and prior approvals.

requirements.outcome: Generate bounded individual drafts using the approved strategy and minimized current facts, with explicit missing-evidence outcomes.
original_acceptance_criteria: Each retained variant identifies the facts and approved offer supporting its personalization; invented prices, claims or product IDs are rejected.
Incomplete required history produces abstention, a permitted generic variant or manual review rather than invented preference or verified absence.
Provider failure or oversized required evidence does not silently change model, recipient data destination or approved content.

requirements.title: Revalidate personalized variants at dispatch
requirements.outcome: Carry approved variants through the existing send pipeline while checking current consent, journey state, product and offer eligibility.
original_acceptance_criteria: An intervening purchase, opt-out, source correction or material offer change suppresses or returns the affected variant for review.
Duplicate schedules and retries retain the same logical delivery identity and do not multiply campaign exposure.
A stale variant is never silently regenerated and sent under its old approval; unaffected approved variants may proceed within existing campaign rules.

requirements.outcome: Evaluate strategy correctness and measured commercial outcomes using existing holdout assignments and economic records.

Campaign results preserve original holdout assignment, exposure identity and attribution windows; duplicated events cannot inflate measured effect.
Reported commercial outcomes distinguish synthetic evaluation, observed attributed revenue and estimated incremental effect with uncertainty.
